prompts.name: initial
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve.
Asset: detailed pixel-art primary attack sprite sheet for an existing 2D tower defense white fox character. Input image is the ONLY character identity reference. Preserve its cream-white fox head, very long upright ears, amber eyes, small orange forehead marks, charcoal robe with thin gold edging, dark red scarf and belt, gold round waist charm, ONE large cream tail with orange tip and spiral. TWO legs, TWO anatomically clear paws with dark fingertip claws. No weapon, no new costume, no second tail.
Produce a square transparent sheet with an EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows equal-cell layout. No words, no borders, no floor shadows. All bodies full length, identical scale, identical consistent three-quarter facing SCREEN RIGHT; leave wide transparent gutters around ears, feet, tail and hands. Pixel art crisp stepped edges, deliberate solid color clusters, rich shading but no smooth antialiasing or blurry glow. Not tiny chibi, retain the source's slim standing proportions and character detail.
This is ONE coherent alternating-hand fire-throw attack, natural weight shift and connected wrists/shoulders; not copies rotated or translated. Both palms have their own small orange fire, hovering visibly above the palm with a transparent gap; never hold a shared fire between two hands. Keep the fox standing on its two feet, not floating.
Read cells left to right:
1 READY: feet comfortably planted, both elbows bent in front of torso, near and far palms separately up, one SMALL bright orange-gold flame above EACH palm. Both hands visible, separated, not crossed.
2 LEFT-HAND LOAD: anatomical left/near hand draws back toward near ribs with its flame, near shoulder rotates back, far hand remains up with its own flame. Bend knees subtly, keep feet planted.
3 LEFT-HAND RELEASE: near left arm extends toward screen right with palm open, correct thumb/wrist, fire has departed that palm; far right palm still holds its small fire. Torso follows release, not a rigid idle.
4 LEFT RECOVERY: near elbow bends back halfway; a small rekindling ember above near palm; far arm begins drawing back. Feet stable, robe and tail settle.
5 RIGHT-HAND LOAD: near left palm now holds its own small flame near chest; anatomical right/far hand with its own fire retracts behind the shoulder, clearly attached at shoulder and wrist without swapping arm ownership.
6 RIGHT-HAND RELEASE: far arm extends toward screen right at a slightly higher lane than the first throw, far palm open with no attached fire; near palm holds its flame below chest. One visible near arm and one visible far arm only.
7 RIGHT RECOVERY: far elbow retracts halfway, tiny rekindling ember above far palm, near hand stays open supporting its own flame, body settles.
8 READY RETURN: same clear two-palm ready position and footprint as cell 1, same height, same tail root.
9 PROJECTILE ONLY: no character; two small independent orange-gold fireballs moving screen right, one upper and one lower separated by plenty of transparent space. Each fireball has a bright golden round head at RIGHT with a narrow orange tapered flame tail trailing LEFT. No smoke, no rings. These will be extracted as effects.
Crucial anatomy: preserve left/right hand identity through all cells, no mirrored palms, no bent-back wrists, no third arm, no merged sleeves, no claw floating from fingers. Robe hem must not merge the two feet. Keep ears fully inside each cell. Orange fire effects remain separate from fur and sleeves; no flame crosses face or ears. Full alpha transparent background.

prompts.name: layout
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing 3-by-3 pixel-art white fox attack sheet. Change ONLY the sheet layout/gutters, preserving these exact eight character poses, arm ownership, visual identity, orange fires, and two fireball effects. The top row ears currently touch the top edge and the lower poses are too close to row boundaries. Redraw the SAME complete sprites at a uniform 85 percent scale within each cell, leaving at least 35 pixels of fully transparent clear margin at EVERY edge of EVERY cell, including above all ears and below all toes. Strict 3 columns by 3 rows square equal-cell arrangement, no overlap or clipping, no added text/grid/shadow. Maintain exact consistent pixel-art style, two separate fire-holding hands and correct alternating left/far right arm throw. Transparent background. Do not change anatomy, no extra limb, no new design.

prompts.name: head_direction
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Target is this transparent 3x3 pixel white fox attack sheet. Change ONLY the head/face direction in cells 1,4,7,8 (the ready/recovery poses which currently look left). Make their nose and eyes turn toward SCREEN RIGHT, using the same right-facing three-quarter face as cell 2, while retaining white fur, long ears, amber eyes and orange forehead marks. Do NOT mirror bodies or tail or hands. Keep ALL the bodies, sleeves, wrists, individual palm fires, footprint, tail roots, scarf, original canvas positions, clear gutters and projectile-only last cell unchanged. Preserve left and right arm ownership. Do not introduce extra ears or asymmetrical head scale. The fox's two eyes should focus toward the attack direction, SCREEN RIGHT. No text/grid/background, maintain exact crisp shaded pixel art with transparent alpha.
